current_suggestion.pitch: You asked for more Stoicism and long-form essays. This channel covers them in a form your list lacks: scripted, narrated 10-25 minute essays instead of interviews or news-style commentary. Episodes work through Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, Epictetus, Nietzsche, existentialists and depth psychology, and ask what a good life is and how to face adversity. It suits the inner-game side of poker, such as tilt, variance and meaning under uncertainty, and it grounds ideas in primary texts rather than productivity-style advice.
